items.title: Ellis Marsalis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 7, 2020
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I’m very privileged to have Ellis Marsalis with me today.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in New Orleans for the Jazz Education Network conference in 2020 and I’m very privileged to have Ellis Marsalis with me today. Thank you for your time. I’ve been reading about your accomplishments and your career. And it seems to me that you’ve got a number of legacies as a performer and educator and mentor, and as the Marsalis family’s been added; to the Battistes and the Humphreys and all that. So congratulations.
